claims.summary: Timberlake describes a free-infinitive construction with negative existential pronouns such as некому and states that negation is carried by the pronoun, not the infinitive; the entry is limited to this construction.

locator.label: § 5.10.5, p. 364, lines 13645–13664; negative existential pronouns in не- combine with a free infinitive and encode the absence of a possible participant.
